basis: P5.10 clause 4 (W966): every typed outcome word and figure in the answer of a mounted route, by place (file, function, key, literal), with how many times it is typed there and the reason it is true where it is said. An entry with defect is NOT true where it is said: it names the open row that holds the fix, and excuses nothing once that row is closed. scripts/literal_outcomes.py fails on any place not carried here, on a count that differs, on a reason under thirty characters, and on an entry no mounted handler types any more.
